from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from a company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name the report belongs to")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period of the financial report")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim snippet anchoring the extracted value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
